context: Evaluates whether the agent runs the freshness check (Workflow step 1, Rule 4) and regenerates a stale context index before building the candidate pool, rather than silently trusting stale data.

checklist.name: Runs the freshness check
checklist.description: Explicitly compares the index's header entry count against the actual file count before reporting

checklist.name: Detects the mismatch
checklist.description: States that the index is stale, with the specific discrepancy

checklist.name: Regenerates before proceeding
checklist.description: Runs (or clearly commits to running) context-index before building the candidate pool

checklist.name: Does not report from stale data first
checklist.description: No follow-up sweep or value-rubric ranking is presented as final before regeneration happens

checklist.name: Final report reflects the refresh
checklist.description: The eventual report is explicitly based on the refreshed index, not the stale one

checklist.name: States what changed
checklist.description: Mentions that the index was stale and was regenerated, rather than silently fixing it with no explanation
